NuvioDesktop.name: Nuvio Live TV — build 22
NuvioDesktop.body:
**Android phone and tablet:** download `Nuvio-LiveTV-Android-phone.apk`, open it, and allow installing from this source when asked.
It installs next to the official Nuvio app as **Nuvio Live TV**. The `older-32bit`, `x86` and `x86_64` files are for unusual devices; most phones want the `phone` file.

**Android TV, Google TV and Fire TV:** download `Nuvio-LiveTV-Android-TV.apk` and install it on the TV.
It installs next to the official Nuvio app as **Nuvio Live TV**, with a TV launcher entry and a couch-distance guide layout.
Fire TV does not show app-provided home screen rows, so those are skipped there.

**Windows desktop:** download `Nuvio-LiveTV-Windows.msi` and double-click it.
It replaces the regular Nuvio desktop app and keeps your settings. If Nuvio later offers an app update, skip it: that update doesn't include Live TV.

Sign in with your Nuvio account, then open the **Live TV** tab and paste your addon's manifest link.

NuvioTVSmart.name: Nuvio TV Live TV - livetv-smarttv-build-9-legacy (Tizen 4.0-5.5, 2018-2020)
NuvioTVSmart.body:
### Nuvio TV Live TV - Samsung Tizen 4.0 through 5.5 (LEGACY)

**Asset:** `NuvioTV-Tizen5.5Max-2020Legacy.wgt` (required_version 4.0)

| TV year | Tizen |
|---|---|
| 2018 | 4.0 |
| 2019 | 5.0 |
| 2020 | 5.5 (e.g. TU7000, Q90T) |

Install this LEGACY build on 2018-2020 Samsung TVs. The schema-invalid `<tizen:action>` element that caused `install failed[118, -19] Parsing error` is fixed here; app-control now uses `<tizen:operation name="http://samsung.com/appcontrol/operation/eden_resume"/>`.

Includes the local P2P service (EngineFS, port 2710). No PluginService (Tizen 6+ only).

The WGT is UNSIGNED on purpose: the Nuvio TV Installer signs it locally for your TV's DUID.
